caption: The drawing depicts a single large, old, and weathered metallic bell lying on its side against a plain, light background. The bell is colored in shades of brown and sepia, giving it a monochromatic appearance. At the top, there is a mount for hanging, though it is partly worn or broken. Around the upper circumference of the bell is a raised band with raised lettering in all caps, partially visible as "D S.T. LAV." The surface of the bell is rough, with visible dents, abrasions, and irregularities. There are areas of shadow on the right side and beneath the bell, suggesting a light source from the left. The overall shape of the bell is conical, flaring out at the base with thickened and uneven edges, and there are no other objects or designs present in the composition.
title: Church Bell
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
